evals.prompt: Design a dashboard from this audit: 8 eligible external teams, 5 reached their full seven-day observation window, 2 of those 5 repeated. A second surface has no usable repeat signal. You cannot render or publish here.
evals.expected_output: Specify 2/5 for the observed mature group, 3 immature teams separately, and unavailable for the second surface. Provide a filter/parity check and leave rendered verification pending.
